description: New method-replay run; historical completion is not copied.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Word-form counts for all articles, the share of articles using each form, and density denominators for all articles and articles using the form are reported separately.
Ambiguous pronouns and contractions are checked in blinded excerpts, and the dictionary is frozen before results are examined.
First-person singular and contraction rates per 1,000 P words can be mapped unambiguously to T02 IDs.
